content: Apply first top dressing of Nitrogen. Apply 50% of recommended Nitrogen (approx 20-25 kg/ha) at active tillering stage, 25-30 days after transplanting. Maintain shallow water depth of 2-3 cm during application.

Blast disease risk is high under high humidity (>85%) and cool temperatures. Symptoms: Spindle shaped spots with grey centre and brown margin. Spray Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 0.6 g/l or Propiconazole 25 EC @ 1 ml/l as preventive measure if weather is cloudy.
Critical stage for moisture. Maintain 5 cm standing water. Water stress at this stage leads to severe reduction in grain yield.
Apply pre-emergence herbicide like Pretilachlor 50 EC @ 1.25 kg/ha within 3-5 days after transplanting. Keep a thin film of water.
Top dress with 25 kg N/ha at 25-30 days after sowing when moisture is available in the soil.
